title: Clock Time Accuracy Issues
summary: This topic is mainly about clock timekeeping and daylight-saving reset problems, but many sampled fragments are unrelated uses of the word "keep," which limits coherence.

positive.summary: Positive feedback mentions that the clock face size is comfortable to read.

negative.summary: Negative feedback centers on clocks being inaccurate, failing to sync automatically, or not updating correctly for daylight saving time, with one fragment also appearing unrelated to clock function.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments are mostly unrelated mentions of "keep" and do not clearly express sentiment about the vehicle clock feature.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are unrelated to the clock topic because they only contain generic uses of the word "keep."
